name: FluxWorks
title: FluxWorks
author: Raziphel, FluidNatalie
description: A massive Factorio overhaul mod! Includes adapted third-party art/concepts from brevven's MIT-licensed resource mods, Rocket Reusability by Lylac, notnotmelon's MIT-licensed deep-storage-unit and fluid-memory-storage mods, plus credited Artisanal Reskins / unused-renders asset work; late teleporter behavior is also inspired by Telogistics by S6X. See credits.md for details.
